sections.Profile:
Surfers, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in December 1967, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a beach and surfing theme. Designed by Ted Zale, the game features three flippers—two at the bottom and one upper flipper—three pop bumpers, and a distinctive "Zipper Flippers" mechanism that closes the gap between the flippers when activated, reducing the chance of the ball draining.
